\n<Tutorial>Hazuki Ichinose is the heroine of this game and
your love interest. Depending on your actions, her
\c[27]Affection\c[0] and \c[2]Vigilance\c[0] will change.
\n<Tutorial>Gaining \c[27]Affection\c[0] means your relationship is
improving. This value represents Hazuki's impression
of you and how much she trusts you.
\n<Tutorial>Conversely, be very careful with \c[2]Vigilance\c[0].
This represents how wary Hazuki is of you as well
as of her surroundings in general.
\n<Tutorial>\c[2]When Hazuki's Vigilance reaches 100, it will very
likely result in a game over, so make sure to keep
it under control at all times.\c[0]
\n<Tutorial>You can raise and lower \c[27]Affection\c[0] as you see fit,
but always keep a close eye on Hazuki's \c[2]Vigilance\c[0].
You can check the values in the menu at any time.
